# Autocomplete density and selected-row styling move into shared mail theme scopes

This landing moves default, compact and touch autocomplete sizing from compose-only variables into shared variables.css and puts list/selected-row rules in messenger.css. The composer keeps result-type icons on the inner autocomplete-row-item, with an RTL background offset and logical start padding. Fixed accepted consumers include compose recipient, Calendar attendee and mailing-list autocomplete inputs; all three compose platform wrappers load the shared styles. The Linux address-book margin exception remains. This is a scoped CSS integration fact, not a global token, selector or !important rule. Toolkit-generated row contracts, computed styling, contrast and keyboard behavior were not executed or fully paired.

Scope: Shared mail autocomplete theme.
